purpose: Per-airport fine-tuning of the 32-epoch context network (27 Sep 2026 lever search). The four GPU-sprint design networks e32_s1..4 (fit on the seasonal fold's fit partition, October monitored) are each fine-tuned on one airport's fitting rows and re-predict that airport's October rows; compared with the same networks' own October predictions. Motivation: unmatched LTFM/LFPG/EGLL rows carry ~35% of the projected ranking error (docs/error_map/), and airport-specific trees helped the earlier stacks (phase-4 airport_blend).

readings.per_airport: 4-seed mean fine-tuned vs 4-seed mean base on the airport's October rows: RMSE change %, matched/unmatched, paired-day bootstrap interval
readings.go: an airport GOes when a setting improves its October RMSE by at least 1.0% with the day interval below zero; the setting is then fixed per the rule 'best mean over all airports' (one setting for all airports, no per-airport choice) before any development round. A GO needs its own declared development round (seasonal/forward/December folds) and the unchanged recipe rule before anything ships.

execution.hardware: AWS L40S via SkyPilot (infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20260927.json), queued on each node after the time-gap test
